feed.title: Awesome DSH Plugin — Curated DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Plugin List

entry.title: deepseek-harness-tui
entry.summary: A Rust/ratatui terminal client that speaks the DSH SDK JSON-RPC protocol directly and runs standalone or as a profile bundle.

entry.title: dsh-balance-meter
entry.summary: DeepSeek account balance and session cost in the composer dock, with auto-fetched official pricing and peak/off-peak support.

entry.title: dsh-plugin-deepseek-balance
entry.summary: DeepSeek API balance, balance trend, and daily usage charts in DSH Web settings.

entry.title: ds-api-usage
entry.summary: DeepSeek API balance and 24-hour usage dashboard in Settings, with estimated spend, token counts, request counts, and an hourly timeline.

entry.title: dsh-TUI
entry.summary: Claude Code-style full-screen terminal UI: pixel-whale header, live status line, and streaming thought expansion.

entry.title: DSH-better-sidebar
entry.summary: Full sidebar workbench with file rendering and editing, terminal, Git, and subagents; third-party plugins can register new tabs.

entry.title: dsh-sticky-disclosure
entry.summary: One-click collapse of every expanded section (Think rows, tool cards) with a live-count pill and a customizable hotkey.

entry.title: dsh-sticky-note
entry.summary: Quick sticky notes on the composer toolbar: jot ideas or TODOs, auto-saved as Markdown, one click to send into the chat.

entry.title: dsh-web-attention-badge
entry.summary: Attention reminders: frame badge, tab-title count, and a status-colored whale favicon for sessions waiting for input or finished unopened.

entry.title: dsh-skin
entry.summary: Codex-style skin switcher plus a custom wallpaper layer with opacity and blur controls.

entry.title: dsh-crosstalk
entry.summary: Cross-session messaging for DSH: any session on the machine can list and message any other, Claude Code-style, via a local heartbeat registry and inbox.

entry.title: dsh-mneme
entry.summary: Cross-session memory: SQLite with a human-editable Markdown mirror, background consolidation (dedup, merge, conflict resolution), and six memory tools.

entry.title: nowledge-mem-deepseek-harness
entry.summary: One memory layer for every AI tool and agent: Context Bundle injection, prompt-time recall, MCP tools, and turn-end DSH thread capture.

entry.title: dsh-memory
entry.summary: Cited memory over DSH's lossless session log: distilled facts carry `(sessionId, eventRange)` citations that expand back to the exact original log excerpt.

entry.title: dsh-memory-vault
entry.summary: Cross-session memory vault: remember / recall / forget tools, per-turn prompt injection, and a settings-page entry browser.

entry.title: dsh-plugin-asmemory
entry.summary: Action-state time memory: record typed states and actions, then analyze trends, anomalies, and causality.

entry.title: dsh-file-claim
entry.summary: File claim/release protection for parallel DSH sessions on the same workspace (heartbeat stale takeover, pending 3-way merge area).

entry.title: dsh-interconnect
entry.summary: Cross-instance message and event handoff between DSH instances via an interconnect server.

entry.title: dsh-bash-terminal
entry.summary: One shell tool for PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL on Windows plus an interactive PTY terminal; the default terminal is chosen by the user in DSH settings.

entry.title: dsh-cowork
entry.summary: Bounded, cell-addressed `doc_read`/`doc_write` for xlsx / pdf / docx / pptx / ipynb, plus an MCP server and CLI.

entry.title: dsh-skillport
entry.summary: Bring your existing Agent Skills (SKILL.md) library to DSH: discover skills across Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini paths, inject a progressive-disclosure index, and load bodies on demand.

entry.title: dsh-apple-mode
entry.summary: Xcode AI integration for DSH: 26 Xcode MCP tools (mcpbridge) + Apple platform skills + Xcode Intelligence-style persona (agent preset or global bundle).

entry.title: dsh-continual-evolve
entry.summary: Continual self-evolution: versioned, auditable, rollback-safe harness state (prompts, memory, skills, subagent specs) refined from session trajectories, with review gates and hot-reloaded skills.

entry.title: dsh-recommend
entry.summary: Transparent rankings and recommendations for the DSH plugin ecosystem: daily auto-fetched topic data, an open scoring model, and rank/search/recommend tools with a settings-page leaderboard.

entry.title: modlens
entry.summary: Vision bridge for text-only models: paste an image, get structured JSON evidence (OCR, layout, semantics).

entry.title: dsh-find-plugin
entry.summary: Find plugins without leaving the agent: search this curated registry by keyword or category, with ready-to-run install commands.

entry.title: dsh-code-intel
entry.summary: Indexes workspace symbols with Tree-sitter and provides lexical or optional embedding-assisted code search.

entry.title: dsh-subagent-tools
entry.summary: Per-call model, provider, persona, and toolFilter overrides for subagent delegation, with @preset: references and provider/model composite ids.

entry.title: dsh-subagent-cwd
entry.summary: Extends dsh-subagent-tools with a per-call cwd for subagents, shipped with the two in-process provider patches it requires.

entry.title: dsh-voice
entry.summary: Voice notes in, spoken answers out: dictate audio that becomes user messages (transcribe), have the agent read replies aloud (speak), local-first under ~/.dsh/voice.
